title: Runtime Slice Manifest
description: Defines one closed executable slice and its position in a parent issue sequence.

schema.description: Discriminator identifying the closed slice-manifest contract.

sliceID.description: Stable logical identity of the slice; independent of its GitHub issue number.

parent.description: Coordinates of the parent orchestration issue.

predecessor.description: Immediate predecessor slice, or null for the first slice.

next.description: Immediate successor slice, or null for the terminal slice.

objective.description: Single bounded outcome the active session must produce.

inputs.description: Prior artifacts, decisions, or evidence admitted as inputs to this slice.

allowedMutationPaths.description: Repository-relative paths or path prefixes that this slice may modify.

forbiddenMutationPaths.description: Repository-relative paths that remain explicitly outside the slice boundary.

focusedValidation.description: Commands required to validate the slice-specific implementation.

closureValidation.description: Repository-level commands required before the slice may be declared complete.

completionCriteria.description: Observable conditions that must hold before the slice is complete.

nonGoals.description: Capabilities or changes that must not be introduced by this slice.

sliceReference.description: Logical and remote coordinates of an adjacent slice.

sliceID.description: Stable logical identity of the referenced slice.

issue.description: GitHub issue number containing the referenced slice manifest.

command.description: Exact executable command declaration without shell-string token inference.
Exact shell text; consumers must not synthesize argv by splitting it.
